findings.summary: The every-spec cuts in 5beb84d lose no rule. Bootstrap: "before edits, stateful runtime work, or packet preparation" is cut from the skill, but "Its first action is the documented project bootstrap" implies it and worktrees.md:93 (every-spec, in every packet readFirst) keeps the full clause. "Do not ask merely because a review failed": removed, but the new "Ask only when proceeding needs an explicit override and no trusted human acceptance ... exists", after "first fix straightforward failures", still forbids it. "instead of only announcing passes": the stage-update rule stays; reporting blockers first and never calling failed evidence passing stay in the same paragraph. "The session-end summary lists every held spec again" -> "Session end lists every held spec" (dispatch.md:103 keeps the old line). "relevant existing decision/context paths" -> "relevant decision/context paths" widens, not narrows. The completion-guidance and testing.md tag sentences are rewordings only.
findings.assumption: An explicit negative that the remaining "only when" sentence fully entails counts as kept. Only the explicit "do not ask merely because a review failed" wording is gone; an owner who wants it spelled out can restore it for about 8 words.

findings.summary: d38f00b raises the hard-coded on-demand bound in [AC:spec-18-4]-style and [AC:spec-19-4] checks from 17663 + 2000 to 17663 + 3500. Under the Test changes rules this is a changed expected value that a line requires: specs 18 and 19 say "on-demand files stay inside their budget", and the brief decision on-demand-budget (clarified, answer plus-1500) moves that budget, as the comment says. It matches the guard ON_DEMAND_CAP, so nothing is weakened beyond the owner decision. Neither spec's Test changes section names the new value (so, strictly, a class-1 line with no stated value declares nothing); this is spec 18/19 scope, not spec 22. Both files copy the literal instead of reading ON_DEMAND_CAP from the guard source (text-fault-proof already parses that file for EVERY_SPEC_FILES), so the next budget change needs three edits.
findings.assumption: A rebaseline that follows a clarified owner decision and equals the guard cap is required, not a weakening.
